One handoff at a time.

Coordinator preparation, specialist approval and local completion stay separate. Missing notes keep a case blocked.

What this prototype tests

Maya Chen is a fictional coordinator, not a validated participant. This design tests whether a clear next owner and a small work queue help staff recognise gaps and finish handoffs. It adds coordination steps; a solo specialist may prefer the document workspace. No time savings or customer demand are claimed.
